title: Add validation to wave function for non-string input
body:
Extend wave(name) to raise TypeError with a descriptive message if name is not a string. Update the existing test to also test TypeError for integer or None input.

Files: orgos/agile/wave.py, tests/agile/test_wave.py

Done: validation works, all tests pass.

votes.justification: The change is small and well-defined: add a type check and raise TypeError in wave(), then update the existing test with two new test cases. No design risk or external dependencies, so 2 points is appropriate.

This is small — a single type check with clear exception raising, and the existing test suite already covers the happy path, so adding a few more test cases is straightforward. The risk is low because the change is isolated and well-understood; the main effort is ensuring the error message is descriptive and consistent.

The change is small and localized to adding a type check in one function and updating an existing test. No security-sensitive patterns (secrets, tokens) are introduced, and the diff is minimal and safe.
